+class _ThinkingTracker:
+    """Tells, segment by segment, whether a stream is inside a thinking block.

+    Looks only at each new segment plus a few carried characters (a tag can

464	    """Read one reply from a token stream, stopping at `max_tokens` of answer.
465	
466	    `enable_thinking=False` only works when the model's chat template reads
467	    it. A model that thinks anyway would spend the budget on text that is
468	    stripped from the answer, so thinking tokens are not counted against
469	    `max_tokens`. The caller caps the stream at `max_tokens` plus
470	    `THINKING_HEADROOM_TOKENS`, which bounds the thinking.
471	    """

473	    # output starts inside it and carries only the closing tag.

622	def _strip_thinking(text: str) -> str:
623	    """Remove reasoning/thinking blocks from generated text.
624	
625	    Handles multiple formats:
626	    - <think>...</think> (Qwen, DeepSeek)
627	    - <channel|>...<|channel> and <|channel>...<channel|> (Gemma 4)
628	    """
629	    return _remove_thinking(text).strip()

632	def _remove_thinking(text: str) -> str:
633	    """`_strip_thinking` without trimming the whitespace around the answer."""
634	    import re
635	
636	    # <think>...</think> — greedy within blocks, DOTALL for multiline
637	    text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", text, flags=re.DOTALL)
638	    # Unclosed <think> at the start — strip everything from <think> onward
639	    if "<think>" in text:
640	        text = text[: text.index("<think>")]
641	    return _strip_gemma_channel_blocks(text)
642	
643	
644	def _strip_gemma_channel_blocks(text: str) -> str:
645	    """Strip Gemma 4 reasoning blocks in either channel-token order."""
646	    result: list[str] = []
647	    rest = text
648	
649	    while True:
650	        normal = rest.find("<channel|>")
651	        reversed_ = rest.find("<|channel>")
652	
653	        if normal == -1 and reversed_ == -1:
654	            break
655	
656	        if normal != -1 and (reversed_ == -1 or normal <= reversed_):
657	            start, open_tag, close_tag = normal, "<channel|>", "<|channel>"
658	        else:
659	            start, open_tag, close_tag = reversed_, "<|channel>", "<channel|>"
660	
661	        result.append(rest[:start])
662	        rest = rest[start + len(open_tag) :]
663	
664	        end = rest.find(close_tag)
665	        if end == -1:
666	            return "".join(result)
667	        rest = rest[end + len(close_tag) :]
668	
669	    result.append(rest)
670	    return "".join(result)
